provenance: Source programs recovered verbatim from the two successful original tool calls. Reran those unchanged programs to persist stdout. Both persisted outputs match the successful original tool outputs byte for byte.
source_kind: Exact recovered original numerical tests; no replacement tests.
interpretation_limits: These tests are floating-point corroboration, not proofs or interval certificates.
The first program uses eigenvalue support threshold 1e-10*max(1,lambda_max) and violation tolerance 1e-8.
The second uses eigenvalue support threshold 1e-11*max(1,lambda_max) and violation tolerance 1e-7.
A true tiny positive eigenvalue can be classified as zero by these numerical support masks; the report explicitly restricts their evidentiary role.
Scalar p=1e-20 is evaluated by the exact closed-form cost rather than the numerical support mask.
